name: Prismfantip
description: Opens with both fans closed before the chest in the court salute and takes the first blow on them.

name: Waft Banner
description: Raps both shut fans across the opponent's wrists in quick turn to loosen the grip.

name: Surging Rimrib
description: Steps to the corner of an imagined court square and turns to face the opponent from the side.

name: Pallrimrib
description: Parts the salute into a deflection by one fan and a counter cut by the other.

name: Waftvow
description: Brushes the opponent's weapon aside with both fans together and steps into the opened line.

name: Crushing Foldedge
description: Crosses the open fans over the opponent's forearms and presses down to bind both arms.

name: Magmafanout
description: Moves through a measured dance of both fans that gathers qi and ends in a wide sweeping cut.

name: Steelfanrib
description: Holds two spread fans edge to edge as one broad screen that takes arrows and thrown blades.

name: Skyborne Silkface
description: Crosses the court floor in one unseen step behind a flash of the spread fans.

name: Choral Wavering Verdict
description: The school's closing form in which both fans guard and bind and strike in matched turn.

name: Prismfanrib
description: Holds the fans on two tracks high and low so that a blow on either line meets a leaf.

name: Paramount Fantip
description: Cuts along one track with the outer rib and returns on the other to the same spot.

name: Delugefanrib
description: Hops from one track to its neighbour with the fans held steady at the hips.

name: Masterful Flutter
description: Flicks both leaves open on different tracks so the opponent's eyes cannot follow either.

name: Quenched Fanrib
description: Cuts on the near track then switches to the far track in a slip that leaves the opponent's reach.

name: Rimribvow
description: Runs both sets of ribs parallel along an arm and closes them to lock it straight.

name: Pall Guardrib
description: Parries on one track and crosses to the other track to strike the opening it makes.

name: Rivetpin Crown
description: Beats on both tracks in turn and drives the opponent backward one pace at a time.

name: Thunderclap Rustle
description: Sends both fan tips down their tracks to cross at the guard and split it open.

name: Undefiled Pivotpin
description: Parts a charge between the two tracks of the spread fans so it passes harmlessly to either side.

name: Royal Spreadface
description: Brings both tracks to one point at the chest with qi gathered in each fan tip.

name: Tenet Fanspine
description: The school's closing form that runs two tracks in one chain of guard and counter and bind and pierce.

name: Unyielding Rimrib
description: Holds the fan rim at eye level and watches over it with the chest and throat covered.

name: Vigorrustle
description: Jabs the folded tip like a beak into the soft place under the ribs.

name: Fantip Heraldry
description: Hops lightly on the toes with spread fans catching air and lands a pace clear.

name: Gallant Fanout
description: Circles the opponent in a wide curve and slashes at the flank on the second pass.

name: Thrall Rivetpin
description: Folds the fan over a thrusting arm like a wing closing and holds the wrist between the ribs.

name: Peal Fanrib
description: Reads the opponent's shoulders and hips over the fan rim to know which line the cut will take.

name: Foldedge Decree
description: Beats the spine down on a guard then rises and beats it again from above.

name: Matchless Silkface
description: Throws the open fan from a high guard so it drops on the target like a diving hawk.

name: Statute Pivotpin
description: Spreads the fan as wide as the arm allows and walks behind its leaf against a hail of missiles.

name: Interstice Spreadface
description: Blurs upward and drops in a single streak to cut the opponent from directly above.

name: Waftdecree
description: The school's closing form that turns the hawk's watch circle and stoop into one chain of fan moves.

name: Statute Guardrib
description: Holds the open fan before the chest as a basin mouth to catch and spill a blow.

name: Famed Snapshut
description: Cuts down along a sloped line from the shoulder to the opposite hip with the outer rib.

name: Feather Snapshut
description: Steps down and forward in a short run as if flowing downhill into the opponent's guard.

name: Sigilrimrib
description: Hooks the opponent's sleeve and draws them into the low center of the stance.

name: Foldedge Seal
description: Catches a cut in the dip of the open leaf then tips it away and strikes in the opening.

name: Entropy Rustle
description: Runs along the rim of the guard as if to flank then cuts back through the middle.

name: Triumphant Flutter
description: Gathers qi in the curved leaf until it spills over and sweeps outward in a flat cutting wave.

name: Gloomrustle
description: Presses the open fan steadily forward so the opponent's stance sinks lower with every breath.

name: Prismrimrib
description: Catches a volley in the curve of the fan and pours it back at the sender.

name: Tenet Wavering
description: The school's closing form that draws the foe in and holds and returns his force in one chain.

name: Prism Fanspine
description: Sets the fan along the line of an imagined riverbank and lets blows pass along it.

name: Thunderclap Waft
description: Cuts the thin outer rib across the opponent's cheek and throat like a reed blade.

name: Squall Spreadface
description: Hops pace to pace as across stepping stones with the fan hand held level.

name: Squall Silkface
description: Crosses the open leaf over a cut and answers with the rib across the neck.

name: Sigil Fanspine
description: Hooks the lead leg at the ankle and hauls it back as a ford drags at wading feet.

name: Quenched Rimrib
description: Beats a steady flow of strokes on the guard from a centred stance until it breaks.

name: Phantasm Snapshut
description: Takes a formal court pace as a feint and then cuts through the line the opponent left open.

name: Inferno Rivetpin
description: Gathers qi like rising water in the leaf and sweeps it out as a broad curved cut.

name: Quenched Guardrib
description: Thrusts the rib through the narrow gap in a guard with qi packed into the tip.

name: Fantipvow
description: Taps the closed fan on the opponent's sternum so the flow of their qi stills for a moment.

name: Resonant Season Rustle
description: The school's closing form that flows from bank guard through ford and crescent to a final tap.

name: Sacrosanct Fanrib
description: Raises the fan rim to the sky and holds it so its shadow covers the chest.

name: Imperial Pivotpin
description: Cuts the open edge across the guard hand in a single clean arc of the deep-blue leaf.

name: Rustleboon
description: Steps along a level line like a skyline and keeps the fan at the same height throughout.

name: Pallwaft
description: Spreads the leaf fully so its deep blue fills the opponent's sight for an instant.

name: Guardrib Seal
description: Draws the fan back from a cut like a bow and releases it into a counter at the wrist.

name: Vising Flutter
description: Drapes the open leaf over a weapon arm like a veil and tightens the ribs to hold it.

name: Surging Pivotpin
description: Slips along the edge of the opponent's reach like a cloud edge and slashes as the body passes.

name: Fantip Edict
description: Beats the rib on the ribcage at the top of the opponent's breath to stall the next move.

name: Majestic Waft
description: Draws a vast breath of qi into the fan and bursts it forward in a sweeping crescent.

name: Devout Silkface
description: Raises the open fan overhead and spreads a dome of qi across a wide space around the user.

name: Volition Fanout
description: Sweeps the fan overhead to press a heavy sky of qi down on the opponents beneath it.

name: Harmonious Foldedge Banner
description: The school's highest form that joins guard and counter and bind and burst under one raised fan.

name: Steelrimrib
description: Plants the feet on bare ground and holds the fan before the chest in the manner of the oath.

name: Thunderclap Fantip
description: Slashes the outer rib across the opponent's forearm in a low flat arc.

name: Fanribsolace
description: Steps along the windward edge of the ground with the open fan carried high.

name: Wavering Reliquary
description: Flicks the fan sharply on a held breath so the sound startles the opponent.

name: Parity Fanspine
description: Turns a cut aside on the leaf and slips along the wind to the opponent's rear flank.

name: Peremptory Fanrib
description: Hooks a weapon arm along a chosen bearing and pulls it clear of the body.

name: Vigor Rimrib
description: Beats the guard once and turns on the heel so the next blow comes from the open side.

name: Bedrock Rivetpin
description: Chains cuts along one sworn line and steps forward on each stroke without breaking the line.

name: Tempestuous Wavering
description: Gathers qi into the open leaf and sweeps it so a gale of cutting wind crosses the plateau.

name: Stalwart Pivotpin
description: Fans a rushing screen of wind before the body that turns arrows and thrown spears aside.

name: Ethereal Fanout
description: Rides a pulse of qi-driven wind across the open ground and arrives beside the foe.

name: Symphonic Tenet Flutter
description: The school's closing form that binds each oath guard and cut and sweep into one chain.

name: Fanribseal
description: Holds the fan angled into the wind so a blow from the front slides across it.

name: Snapshut Triumph
description: Draws the fan from the sash in a cut that begins with the wind at the user's back.

name: Bedrock Fanout
description: Hops on a gust with the leaf lifted and lands one pace nearer the target.

name: Undefiled Silkface
description: Takes a cut on the leaf and uses the wind's push to return the edge across the neck.

name: Ruling Rustle
description: Hooks a wrist with the open ribs and lets a gust pull the arm out wide.

name: Storied Spreadface
description: Runs down the wind line slashing with each stride at the guard of the opponent ahead.

name: Magmarustle
description: Gathers qi in the leaf and sends a rushing surge of wind and cutting force across the front.

name: Peal Fanspine
description: Hurls the open fan across the wind so it curves in from the flank to cut the target.

name: Rimribpledge
description: Catches a heavy attack in the wind-filled leaf and turns its force back toward the sender.

name: Harmonious Destiny Rimrib
description: The school's closing form that sweeps guard and counter and surge together before the wind.

name: Steelfantip
description: Fixes the feet on a bearing and holds the fan steady across the body.

name: Dauntless Wavering
description: Cuts exactly down the chosen bearing from the shoulder to the opponent's guard hand.

name: Deluge Rustle
description: Holds a heading while stepping so the body and fan never drift from the line.

name: Squallfantip
description: Turns a thrust aside without losing the bearing and returns a thrust along the same line.

name: Millstone Fanrib
description: Hooks the weapon arm and drags it along the bearing as the user steps off the line.

name: Quenched Waft
description: Beats the guard off its own bearing with a hard rap of the folded ribs.

name: Pallfanrib
description: Feints a change of bearing then returns to the first line before the opponent reacts.

name: Dunefanrib
description: Gathers qi along the bearing and sweeps the fan so a long cutting wind runs down it.

name: Bedrock Flutter
description: Holds the fan on one bearing and presses a steady wind against the advancing opponent.

name: Statute Snapshut
description: Strikes a point on the bearing line so the opponent's breath and qi lock for a heartbeat.

name: Symphonic Volition Spreadface
description: The school's closing form that keeps one bearing through guard and hook and sweep alike.

name: Ironclad Guardrib
description: Stands at the bare edge of the ground with the fan held low to cover the legs.

name: Illustrious Fanout
description: Cuts the bare outer rib across the opponent's wrist without any flourish.

name: Dunewaft
description: Steps along a narrow edge with the fan outstretched like a balancing pole.

name: Imperious Waft
description: Lifts dust and light with a swift upward fan stroke and dazzles the opponent's sight.

name: Devout Rivetpin
description: Turns a blow at the edge of the footing and slashes back across the face.

name: Thrallfanout
description: Hooks the lead foot and hauls it out so the opponent teeters at the edge.

name: Valiant Fantip
description: Rushes into a gap in the guard beating it wider with every stride.

name: Pallfantip
description: Feints a stumble at the edge and turns on the heel to strike the one who follows.

name: Magma Foldedge
description: Gathers qi and sweeps the fan out so a surge of cutting wind runs over the open ground.

name: Fanribvow
description: Spins the open fan in a steady disc before the body so missiles from the open side are swept away.

name: Vacuum Wavering
description: Drives a thin cutting thread of wind through the fan's edge to pass the opponent's guard.

name: Destiny Rustle
description: The school's closing form that runs guard and hook and surge along the bare edge in one chain.

name: Statute Fantip
description: Opens in the canon guard with the fan angled over the heart and the feet firmly set.

name: Squall Rivetpin
description: Cuts the first rib stroke of the canon across the opponent's lead forearm.

name: Fanout Boon
description: Takes one measured pace along the oath line with the fan arm still.

name: Sainted Spreadface
description: Parries in the canon manner and returns the rib in a cut to the throat.

name: Silkface Vow
description: Hooks the sword arm and lifts it overhead as the user steps beneath it.

name: Vigor Pivotpin
description: Beats the guard in the steady rhythm of the canon until its pace overwhelms the opponent.

name: Royal Guardrib
description: Gathers qi to the oath line and sweeps the fan so a gale cuts across the field.

name: Quenched Fanspine
description: Thrusts the canon's sharpest rib down the oath line to break a held guard.

name: Tenet Rimrib
description: Runs guard then hook then sweep then pierce down one oath line carried by a rising gale.

name: Volition Fanrib
description: The school's closing form that fulfils the canon's oath in one unbroken round of fan moves.

name: Fantiptroth
description: Holds the fan out toward the farthest horizon and covers the body behind its leaf.

name: Lordly Foldedge
description: Cuts along a line drawn from the horizon through the opponent's shoulder.

name: Skyborne Flutter
description: Walks steadily toward the horizon line with the fan carried level.

name: Parity Rimrib
description: Turns a cut aside and answers along the farthest bearing with the edge at the wrist.

name: Sigilwaft
description: Hooks a weapon at full reach of the arm and pulls it toward the user's own bearing.

name: Squallrustle
description: Beats the guard with a wind-driven stroke that carries the full length of the arm.

name: Deluge Waft
description: Slips along the horizon line past the guard and cuts from the open far side.

name: Magma Rivetpin
description: Gathers qi toward the horizon and sweeps the fan so a gale reaches far across the plateau.

name: Fanribbanner
description: Throws the open fan on the farthest bearing so it cuts a target at the edge of sight.

name: Volition Waft
description: Holds the fan overhead and lets a heavy far wind press down on every foe beneath it.

name: Volition Snapshut
description: The school's closing form that carries one bearing from guard to throw to the final far wind.
